visualCharacteristics.purpose: link-list accordions whose items sit side by side in equal columns on desktop
traits: each item has a top rule and a chevron toggle
equal columns from 993px for any number of items, stacked below
all items start collapsed; each opens independently, several may be open

contentPattern.structure: One row per item. Cell 1: title (plain text or a heading; an authored heading keeps its level and wraps the toggle). Cell 2: panel content, usually a bulleted list of links (additional cells are appended to the panel). Items sit in equal columns from 993px (any number), stacked below; all start collapsed and toggle independently. A row without panel content renders its title only, not collapsible. Empty rows are ignored; zero-width characters are removed; external links open in a new tab

usage.description: 'City trips worldwide / Popular routes / Flights from ...' internal link panels on AirCore destination, origin and route pages.

reuseGuidance: Use when several short accordions should sit next to each other as columns. When one panel splits into columns use accordion-columns; for stacked full-width panels use the vanilla accordion.
